name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-copilot-studio-agent-map
title: Agent Map for Copilot Studio agents
shortDescription: SPFx Copilot UX component that shows an interactive map of a Copilot Studio agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot: its skills, tools, knowledge sources, connected agents, topics, triggers, and evaluation sets.
longDescription: Agent Map is an SPFx Copilot UX component that shows how a Copilot Studio agent is built, directly in Microsoft 365 Copilot. A declarative agent ("Agent Map") calls it as a tool. The inline card shows only the map. The full-screen view adds the environment and agent selectors, search, filters, a list, and a details panel for each skill, tool, knowledge source, connected agent, topic, trigger, and evaluation set.

The component reads the agent definition from Dataverse with the signed-in user's delegated identity through AadHttpClient, and finds the environments with the Dataverse Global Discovery Service. It is read-only and needs no backend or Azure resources.
